component.name: Immich Folder Watch
component.summary: Upload media and synchronize local folders with Immich

description.p: Immich Folder Watch uploads photos and videos from local folders or synchronizes folders and albums with your Immich server in both directions. Choose a mode for each folder and control album mapping, file filters, transfer order, and logging. It runs as a per-user desktop app with X11 and XWayland support, talking to Immich over its public HTTP API rather than touching the server's storage directly.

An existing Immich server and an API key are required. Configure the connection after installation, then choose folders and grant access through the desktop folder picker. The linked help page explains setup.
Immich Folder Watch is a community desktop client maintained separately from the Immich project.

ul.li: Automatically upload screenshots into a dedicated Immich album.
Import existing photos and videos, then keep uploading new files.
Synchronize a local folder with one Immich album, including downloads.
Map first-level subfolders to Immich albums and keep media outside albums in the source root.
Per-folder modes for new-file uploads, existing and new uploads, or bidirectional synchronization.

Bidirectional sync propagates supported moves, renames, and deletions. Local deletions trash tracked Immich assets; assets removed from the remote source cause permanent deletion of tracked local files after a successful pull.
Optional album placement for uploads, single-album sync, or subfolders mapped to albums.
Per-folder extension and exclusion filters, with optional permanent local cleanup after verified uploads in upload modes.
Waits until files are fully written before upload; retries transient failures.
Remote change notifications via Socket.IO with polling fallback, plus connection and transfer status in the desktop interface.
Configurable upload/download order, batching, retries, logging, and start on login.
English and German UI with OS auto-detection and live language switching.

description.p: Maintenance release containing the reviewed updates and fixes merged since 3.0.0. The HTTPS-by-default migration requirement introduced in 3.0.0 remains unchanged.

ul.li: Restrict Flatpak release tooling to the trusted default-branch checkout and reject a different release target before executing repository scripts, preventing mixed release inputs and removing the dynamic-checkout cache-poisoning path. Scope Git ownership trust to the exact checkout workspace for container builds.
Restore Flatpak packaging for Microsoft.Data.Sqlite 11.0.0 by preserving the exact upstream MIT license for both Sqlite packages and refreshing attribution.

Retain the xUnit v3 framework version compatible with Avalonia headless tests while updating xUnit v2 and the Visual Studio test runner; preserve serial GUI execution and the existing VSTest workflow.
Restore Flatpak packaging for Microsoft.Extensions 11.0.0 updates by recording reviewed MIT supplements for the complete resolved Microsoft/System package set.
Prevent concurrent watcher/polling callbacks from trashing the same remote asset twice, and retain failed deletion mappings for polling retries.
Weekly Dependabot checks for NuGet packages and SHA-pinned GitHub Actions, with related NuGet packages grouped for review and bounded open update PRs.
Update Microsoft.Extensions and Microsoft.Data.Sqlite to 11.0.0, with reviewed upstream license notices retained in Flatpak packages.
Update pinned artifact upload/download, Pages configuration/deployment and Node setup actions; retain manual dependency review and disabled automatic merging.
Record dependency compatibility reviews, validation results and deferred upgrades in the maintenance documentation.
